mapper.select: SELECT ls.id, ls.user_id AS userId, a.name AS userName, ls.lesson_id AS lessonId, l.title AS lessonTitle, ls.comment, ls.video_url AS videoUrl, ls.feedback, ls.status FROM lesson_submissions ls JOIN lessons l ON ls.lesson_id = l.id JOIN accounts a ON ls.user_id = a.id ORDER BY ls.id DESC

SELECT ls.id, ls.user_id AS userId, a.name AS userName, ls.lesson_id AS lessonId, l.title AS lessonTitle, ls.comment, ls.video_url AS videoUrl, ls.feedback, ls.status FROM lesson_submissions ls JOIN lessons l ON ls.lesson_id = l.id JOIN accounts a ON ls.user_id = a.id WHERE ls.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lesson_submissions ( user_id, lesson_id, comment, video_url, status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{lessonId}, #{comment}, #{videoUrl}, #{status} )
